verdict.rationale: Airwallex webhooks (docs-9, docs-26) push real-time event notifications, and authorization controls (docs-3) let you define card-usage rules, but there is no documented native rules/automation engine that lets a user declare 'on event X, automatically do Y' end-to-end — actions still require custom code consuming the webhook payload. AgentOS (docs-13, docs-28) lets an agent act on the account but is agent-driven, not a declarative rule trigger system.  missing for 10: a built-in workflow/rules engine binding events to automated actions, documentation of conditional logic beyond card authorization controls, evidence of no-code rule builder.
